pages.text: Others have been down here before. In the Crustal Caverns stand $(thing)Deep Boreholes$(): drill holes cased in steel and abandoned two dozen blocks down, a broken drill floor at the top and a cache at the bottom of the hole.

In the Natural Reactor, lead-walled $(thing)Oklo Reactor Ruins$() are dug round the reactor seam itself - fission fragments and uraninite in the floor. Bring a Geiger Counter and radiation-plated armour; their caches hold fuel, graphite and control rods.
